description: This file defines the code-behind for the 'EditExam' ASP.NET Web Forms page, handling button click events to transfer control to other pages within the OnlineExamSystem project.

classes.name: EditExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the EditExam.aspx page, handling page events and navigation actions.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently performs no actions.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event for the home button, transfers to AdminPanel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event for the profile button, transfers to AdminQueue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event for the leaderboard button, transfers to AdminLeaderboard page.

methods.name: eTheoryB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event for the edit theory button, transfers to EditTheory page.

methods.name: eMcqB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event for the edit MCQ button, transfers to EditMCQ page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event for the logout button, transfers to LoginPage.
